_note: All sizes in mm, seat frame S (Z = out of the face, seat at Z = 0). Edit and re-run shell_build.py.

print.material: tough/ABS-like resin, HDT >= 60-70 C, UV clear coat

parting._note: seam at least mic-boss radius (2.1) + 0.3 below the mic/LED centres, so each boss, membrane seat and LED sleeve sits wholly in the cover and the membrane never bridges the seam

seal.gasket: seamless cast 0.8 x 0.8 silicone (or 0.8 mm cord, 50-60 ShA): ~25 % squeeze
seal.type: cured-in-place: bead of MS-polymer (or neutral-cure silicone) laid in the groove at final assembly; the tongue displaces it into a 0.15 mm side gap and 0.6 mm bottom gap; screws hold the halves while it cures (24 h). Dry-fit without sealant first. Alternative for test fits: 0.8 mm silicone cord.

screws.type: M1.2 x 4 titanium or A4 stainless (must be NON-magnetic: they sit near the hook-switch sensor)

mic._note: membrane recess is open to the cavity so the IP68 acoustic membrane can be placed and pressed

pod_socket._note: the body narrows to the neck size just above the pod, so there is no room for a socket AROUND the neck without changing the outside. The opening sits inside the neck outline instead: the pod's top face bonds and seals onto a 1.2 mm rim with flexible MS-polymer; the collar centres it. Real pod-to-body joint unknown - measure on the teardown.

hook.material: flexible resin ~80A (arm); stub is printed with the rigid halves

cell_as_lid.bond: cell bonded + sealed on the 1.2 mm lip with clear MS-polymer or 2-part epoxy bead (no IPA on the cell); pads face the cavity

end_screw._note: optional third screw at the pod end, from the outer face into an insert in the base. Added only if the base under the seam has room for >= min_engagement of thread with min_wall to the outside; on the JBL-model geometry it does not (the paddle tapers into the nozzle neck under a ~45 deg, 1.1 mm wall), so the seam is sealed with a cured-in-place bead and needs no clamping force there.
end_screw.screw: M1.2 (titanium or A4), longest stock length that fits - see shell_report.json end_screw
